sources.retention: restoration-only; bytes must be fetched from the URL and verified by SHA-256; this packet does not redistribute SALB geometries
sources.notes: Official item response retrieved on 2026-10-05. Temporal validity remains 2016-01-01 through last verification/update 2021-09-02. This current response is the script input. A prior 411079-byte response was compared locally: same exact 39 ADM2 codes, names, and ADM1 parents; 19642 coordinate values, 16346 numerically different at serialization precision, maximum delta 5.684341886080802e-14 degrees, all equal after rounding to 9 decimal places. This does not establish legal boundary continuity. The prior restricted raw bytes were not retained and are no longer restorable from this URL.

prior_retrieval_comparison.interpretation: serialization precision difference observed; does not certify legal continuity; prior raw response not retained under SALB restrictions

sources.title: UN SALB Guinea-Bissau FeatureServer layer metadata
sources.notes: Names fields adm1nm, adm2nm, adm1cd, adm2cd; layer states first/second level, 1:1,000,000 suitability, temporal validity, and DGGC/SALB source credit.

sources.title: Guinea-Bissau Toponymic Factfile
sources.notes: Page 4 describes eight regions plus one autonomous sector and says 39 sectors at ADM2 level, pointing to SALB as supplied by DGGC. Compilation date not established beyond 2024 asset context.

sources.title: Guinea-Bissau Fourth National Communication
sources.notes: Page 22 says eight regions are divided into 36 sectors, with Bissau a separate autonomous sector. Direct official PDF returned anti-bot content on current retrieval; saved mirror has exact bytes matching hash from #472 official-context record. Verify hash on restoration.
